heading: INT. ORBITAL STATION KESTREL - AIRLOCK - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. ORBITAL STATION KESTREL - AIRLOCK - CONTINUOUS
Red emergency light.
The hiss of a failing seal.
Frost spreads across the inner door like creeping fingers.
COMMANDER YUSUF AL-RASHID, 40s, helmet off, grips a cutting torch with both hands and strains against a warped hatch.
Beside him, ENGINEER PRISCA DELACROIX-NWOKO, 30s, wrenches at a valve with a pipe.
Her breath fogs in the thinning air.
They work together, shoulders touching, a single frantic machine.
The hatch groans.
A fingertip of vacuum screams through the gap.
Pressure's dropping!
units.name: YUSUF

units.text: I know!
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: They both hit the hatch with their shoulders at the same time.
It shudders but holds.
Yusuf swears.
Prisca swings the pipe once more at the valve and it cracks off its mount, trailing coolant in a silver arc.
They freeze.
That was the last one.
units.name: PRISCA

units.text: Yusuf drops the torch.
It floats, turning slowly in the dim red light.
They stare at it.
At each other.
The hatch sighs shut by itself, and the lights go out.
